panels.description: The train climbs into Oasis: pearl-white architecture, broad reservoirs, geometric gardens and quiet automated transit. Leave upper city space.
Ada scans her band at a clearance gate. Leave upper display space.
Ada presses the largest rivet on her strap while Alex waits beside the civic archive entrance. Leave upper gate space.
Ada steps toward the archive by her own choice while Alex follows only after her. Leave upper civic space.

items.text: VEYRA, A. — RESIDENT RECORD FOUND — STATUS: UNRESOLVED.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: That’s a strange way to say hello.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: I chose to come this far.
